card.name: The word pediatric after adult and
card.fires_on: The word "pediatric" right after "adult and", "adults and", "adult or" or "a" in dosing and warning text. It comes just before "patients".

modes.label: After adult and/or
modes.description: "pediatric" follows "adult(s) and" or "adult or" in a list of patient groups.
modes.example: Reduce the dosing of UPTRAVI to once daily in adult and<< pediatric>> patients on a moderate CYP2C

modes.label: After the article a
modes.description: "pediatric" follows "If a" when describing a single patient switching formulations.
